title: Sales Stack Server Manifest
description: One entry describing a connected sales-engagement MCP server (Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo, or any other) as consumed by the Sales Stack Router's route() function.

server_id.description: Unique identifier for this connected server instance.

priority.description: Lower = preferred when multiple servers can fulfill the same request. Optional; treated as 999 (lowest priority) if omitted.

rate_limit.description: Optional. Omit if the server has no meaningful rate limit for this use case. NOTE: values here are ALWAYS specific to a real account/plan — never hardcode a vendor's advertised limit without checking the account's actual plan, since these change and vary by tier.

usage_this_window.description: Caller-supplied live count. The router holds no state of its own — this must be fresh each call.
